unit.goal: Strona planu ładuje cały plik z domyślnej projekcji trasy detalu, więc „Save” nie gubi końca pliku. Konflikt hasha przy zapisie pokazuje inline baner z jedyną akcją przeładowania. Nie ma opcji nadpisania i plik na dysku nie jest nadpisywany.

orchestratorNotes: Earlier units of this build added src/client/lib/own-writes.ts and an own-echo branch in src/client/hooks/useFileWatcher.ts for briefs and patches. Lessons from their reviews: (1) after a save, write the detail cache from the sent content + the PUT hash instead of re-fetching the whole file; (2) suppress a watcher echo ONLY if this save really produces one (check the server path: pages-frontmatter-indexer broadcasts the artifact event only when frontmatter changed; record-store writes may use chain:false), and never absorb another writer's server-origin event — agents/MCP and other tabs also write with origin 'server'.

Non-blocking leftover from unit m36's review (rev-0001), in a file this unit is likely to touch, src/server/services/plan.ts: `export interface PlanReadOpts` sits inside the import block (move it below the imports), a double blank line after `readForWrite`, and `getByThread` still takes inline `{ range?: ArtifactRange }` while `getByPath`/`getByAddress` take `PlanReadOpts`. Fix it if you touch plan.ts.
